story: Prahlada was the son of the demon king Hiranyakashipu, who hated Vishnu. Prahlada kept chanting Vishnu's name, so his father tried to kill him with poison, elephants, snakes and fire. He survived every time, until Vishnu burst out of a pillar as Narasimha and killed Hiranyakashipu.
belief: Prahlada is one of the greatest devotees in Hindu tradition, proof that faith can survive anything. His story is celebrated on Holi with the Holika bonfire.
turns: His only 'crime' was defying his own father, which the tradition treats as the right choice.
facts: His aunt Holika burned in the fire she meant to kill him with.
He is the grandfather of King Mahabali.
Narasimha Jayanti marks the day he was saved.
